items.title: Jeff Riddick Interview, 1983-07-14
items.q: And Sock Horn, Sterling Bowes, after William Manone left the band, Sterling Bowes joined that band.

ctx.x: And Sock Horn, Sterling Bowes, after William Manone left the band, Sterling Bowes joined that band.

I've got the picture. I can show you the picture of that band. Who's that? Sock? What did you say his name? Sock Horn. What did he play? Sax. Great, big, powerful man. Mm-hmm. I'm just not familiar with him. Where is he from?
From, I don't know. Mm-hmm. I think it was Mobile.
